description: Read your X likes, bookmarks, home feed, threads, profiles and search from Claude.
long_description:
Read-only: the extension never posts, likes or follows.

1. Sign in at https://x.com in Google Chrome (or Arc, Brave or Edge) on this Mac.
2. Ask Claude, for example: "what did I bookmark on X this week?" or "summarize this thread: https://x.com/…". The extension reads your X session from the browser.
3. The first time, macOS may ask whether to allow access to "Chrome Safe Storage": click Always Allow.

If several X accounts are signed in, tell Claude which handle to use, or fill the Account setting of this extension.

account.title: X handle (optional)
account.description: Only when several X accounts are signed in on this Mac: the handle to read as, without @.

needs: Signed in at x.com in Chrome, Arc, Brave or Edge
